summary: Navbar geometry regression validated at 1440x900. Logo fully contained inside the floating pill nav (logo left=155 >= nav left=130; bottom=68 <= nav bottom=82). Phone button and Devis CTA both have border-radius:999px and are horizontally contained (CTA right=1295 <= nav right=1310; phone right=1111.5 <= 1310). Nav .nav has position:fixed and border-radius:999px. Nav links CIBLES/MÉTHODE/SECTEUR/PROS/FAQ present. No .girophare in DOM. Hero CTAs (hero-call, hero-whatsapp, hero-devis) present. Contact form submission returns French success and form-message gets class 'ok'.

issues: Stats bar element exists with class='hero-meta' but is MISSING data-testid='hero-meta' attribute. Visible content ('< 24h', '8', '0€', 'Pro') renders correctly, but the testid selector expected by the test spec is absent. Add data-testid='hero-meta' on the .hero-meta element.

action_items: Add data-testid='hero-meta' attribute to the .hero-meta stats bar element in /app/frontend/public/index.html (element renders visually but selector missing).
critical_code_review_comments: Nav geometry now correct across desktop 1440x900 — logo/height 40px and internal padding (24/14) reliably contains children within the 999px pill.
Single monolithic index.html file — acceptable per spec but note maintainability trade-off.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar containment fix verified. Only remaining minor: hero stats bar element lacks data-testid='hero-meta' (class='hero-meta' present). Contact POST /api/contact returns 200 with French success message; form-msg gains class 'ok'.
